summary: Frontend-only UI testing of the new password management feature (Grand Aceh Kuliner POS) at 1920x900. Verified: (1) admin self change-password dialog from sidebar with all 3 validations (confirm mismatch, <6 chars, wrong current password -> 'Password lama salah' from backend 400) plus a REAL password change to 'GrandAceh#2026TMP' and immediate revert to 'GrandAceh#2026' (both success toasts, dialog auto-closes, re-login with original password verified PASS); (2) kasir login (kasir@grandaceh.com/kasir123) shows 'change-password-btn' in sidebar and dialog opens (no change made); (3) admin reset password on /users: reset-pw-{id} button on Kasir card opens 'Reset Password — Kasir Satu' dialog, <6 chars shows 'Password minimal 6 karakter', successful reset to 'kasir123' shows 'Password Kasir Satu berhasil direset' and closes dialog; subsequent kasir login with kasir123 succeeded, confirming credentials intact; (4) 'Tambah' user dialog opens with name/email/password/role fields + save button rendering correctly, closes on Escape, no junk users created. Both accounts end in their original passwords (admin=GrandAceh#2026, kasir=kasir123).

issues: Password inputs have placeholders only, no visible labels (Users create dialog does use labels) - minor inconsistency

critical_code_review_comments: Layout.jsx ChangePasswordDialog validates new-password length BEFORE confirm mismatch; spec listed mismatch first. Both messages fire correctly, so behaviour is acceptable, but consider checking mismatch first for better UX.
ChangePasswordDialog has no client-side check for empty current password; request goes to backend and returns 400 ('Password lama salah'). Acceptable but a local guard would save a round-trip.
Users.jsx: no confirmation step before admin resets another user's password - a one-click irreversible action; consider a confirm state.
seed_data_creation: None. No users created. Admin password temporarily changed then reverted; kasir password reset to its existing value 'kasir123'.
